finding.source: User supplied external Codex A review, PASS_WITH_FINDINGS
finding.issue: command_valid suppresses a REC sampling boundary even for no-op REC K1-short(command0) or K2-long(command2). If simultaneous with W_EOF/valid EOF/sample_gap0, sample spacing can grow from4 to5 camera frames.
finding.work_static_verification: Confirmed !command_valid is unconditional in next_slot selection; REC command0 and command2 do not change record state. No simulation rerun in this disposition.
finding.impact_boundary: Cadence disturbance; review found no premature registration, read-write collision or clip corruption. Does not establish all possible no-op effects beyond reviewed evidence.
finding.operator_rule: During normal REC wait for automatic completion; do not press K1-short/K2-long or other extra keys. Intentional K1-long cancellation is allowed only in the separate cancellation test.
finding.future_fix: In a later authorized technical revision suppress sampling only for commands actually changing recording state; add coincident W_EOF/EOF/gap0 directed tests and supplemental A review for changed bytes.
